records.Concise description: Centralized exchange founded in 2018 with material bitcoin spot and derivatives markets, custody, APIs and institutional trading.
records.Deeper researched summary: Bybit began as a crypto derivatives venue and expanded into spot and broader multiasset trading. Customer funds on the exchange are custodial until withdrawn. Bybit publishes proof-of-reserves snapshots, including a July 22, 2026 snapshot, but MSC should present those as exchange disclosures rather than proof of total corporate solvency. No current Lightning claim is made in this registry because it was not sufficiently verified.
records.Launch / history: Founded in 2018 as a derivatives-focused exchange and subsequently expanded into spot and institutional products.
records.Why it matters in the Bitcoin exchange e: Bybit is included because Bitcoin derivatives and later spot trading are core to its durable market role, not merely because BTC appears among many listed assets.
records.Verification basis: Current Bybit first-party exchange and proof-of-reserves material verifies active operation, custody/trading role and 2026 reserve disclosures.
Research notes / uncertainties: Do not equate Bybit's proof-of-reserves publication with proof of full corporate solvency.
No Lightning support claim is included without stronger current verification.
Availability and regulatory status vary by jurisdiction.

records.Concise description: One of the longest-running centralized Bitcoin exchanges, founded in 2011 and acquired by Robinhood in 2025.
records.Deeper researched summary: Bitstamp began in Europe in 2011 as a Bitcoin exchange and evolved into a multiasset custodial spot venue. Robinhood completed its acquisition of Bitstamp on June 2, 2025, making current ownership materially different from the original independent company. Bitstamp Europe S.A. announced MiCA CASP authorization in Luxembourg in 2025; that should be described specifically rather than used as a global regulation shorthand.
records.Launch / history: Founded in 2011. Bitstamp became one of Bitcoin's longest-lived fiat exchanges. Robinhood completed its acquisition of Bitstamp in June 2025.
records.Why it matters in the Bitcoin exchange e: Bitstamp provides continuity from Bitcoin's early European fiat-market era into today's institutionally owned, licensed exchange infrastructure.
Important technical or cultural characte: MiCA authorization applies through specified European entity
records.Verification basis: Bitstamp first-party history/current material and Robinhood's 2025 acquisition announcement verify active status, launch lineage and ownership.
Research notes / uncertainties: Ownership changed in 2025; do not present Bitstamp as still independently owned.
MiCA authorization belongs to a specific European entity and does not describe all Bitstamp services worldwide.

records.Concise description: Long-running centralized exchange launched in 2012 with BTC spot/derivatives markets, custody, APIs and Bitcoin Lightning support.
records.Deeper researched summary: Bitfinex has operated since 2012 and remains a custodial multi-market exchange. Users trade from Bitfinex-controlled balances and can withdraw to external wallets. Current support material documents Bitcoin Lightning deposits and withdrawals. The 2016 Bitfinex hack is historically material to exchange-custody history; legal recovery/prosecution details should be attributed to primary authorities and not sensationalized.
records.Launch / history: Founded in 2012. Bitfinex survived a major 2016 security breach and continued operating as a major BTC/USD and crypto trading venue.
records.Why it matters in the Bitcoin exchange e: Bitfinex is significant to Bitcoin market structure through long-lived BTC/USD liquidity, margin/derivatives infrastructure and early/current Lightning integration.
records.Verification basis: Current Bitfinex exchange/support material verifies active BTC markets, withdrawals and Lightning support; historical security context is corroborated by U.S. primary legal sources.
Research notes / uncertainties: Any discussion of the 2016 hack, recovered assets or criminal cases should be dated and sourced to primary authorities.
Lightning functionality should be rechecked immediately before publication.

records.Concise description: U.S.-founded custodial exchange and trust-company platform offering BTC spot trading, custody and institutional services.
records.Deeper researched summary: Gemini launched in 2015 under a New York trust-company charter. Gemini exchange customers use custodial accounts under Gemini-controlled infrastructure until assets are withdrawn. The Gemini Earn program is not the same product as the core exchange and involved a separate lending relationship with Genesis Global Capital; MSC should not merge those legal histories into a claim that the exchange itself was the lender.
records.Launch / history: Founded by Cameron and Tyler Winklevoss and launched in 2015 after receiving a New York trust-company charter.
records.Why it matters in the Bitcoin exchange e: Gemini is historically important as an early U.S. Bitcoin exchange built around the New York trust-charter model and institutional custody.
Important technical or cultural characte: Gemini Earn must be separated from core exchange custody/legal history
records.Verification basis: Current Gemini legal material plus NYDFS primary charter history verify active custodial exchange operation and the 2015 New York trust-company lineage.
Research notes / uncertainties: Gemini Earn was a lending program involving Genesis Global Capital; do not describe it as identical to Gemini's exchange or custody service.
State/country availability must be checked at publication time.
